reason: The Quack Pack is honestly cute and a good colleague gift, but I need it for a birthday coming up and there is no delivery date, just 'once 100 reservations come in'. I'm not paying a deposit for a present that might show up after the party.
objection: No delivery date at all, so it could arrive weeks after the birthday. And as a brand-new brand I can't tell if the socks are really better than the cheap duck socks on Amazon that would arrive in two days.
would_change_my_mind: A firm 'ships by' date, or it being in stock and arriving within a week.
